value.description: Controlled HTML. The editor only rewrites its content when this differs from what it last emitted.

defaultValue.description: Initial HTML when uncontrolled. Sanitized on load.

defaultMarkdown.description: Initial content as Markdown, used when no HTML value is given.

onChange.description: Called after each edit with { html, markdown, text, empty }. HTML is clean: canonical tags and only href attributes.

onHistoryChange.description: Reports whether undo and redo are available, for your own toolbar.

placeholder.description: Shown when the editor is empty.

blockHint.description: The hint on an empty line while the caret is in it.

readOnly.description: Turns off editing, the toolbar, and shortcuts.

autoFocus.description: Focuses the editor on mount with the caret at the end.
